25. The top spectrum is that of nonane and the bottom spectrum is that of 1-hexanol.

Prominent bands in the nonane spectrum include those due to aliphatic CUH stretch- ing modes around 2,900 cm21, UCH2 and UCH3 bending modes near 1,450 and 1,375 cm21, respectively. Prominent bands in the 1-hexanol spectrum include the broad OUH stretch around 3,400 cm21 characteristic of hydrogen-bonded alcohols, UCH2 and UCH3 bending modes near 1,450 and 1,375 cm21 similar to those in nonane, and the CUO stretch around 1,075 cm21, also characteristic of alcohols.
